title: SBI Clerk: identify your drive, review mains and check language requirements
description: Separate SBI Junior Associate regular and special drives, improve mains data and reasoning decisions, and prepare the right language evidence.
intro:
SBI Junior Associate recruitment has separate regular and special-drive advertisements. The special-drive mains is listed for 29 October 2026; that date must not be pasted onto the regular drive. Start every download or study plan by matching the advertisement number in your application.

Use the [special-drive final revision guide](/exams/sbi-clerk/guides/special-drive-mains-final-revision/) for the 29 October handout structure, document checks and original DI drills. The regular /17 recruitment is separate.

sections.title: Match the advertisement before the date
sections.body:
The special drive discussed in our [29 October update](/exam-updates/sbi-clerk-special-drive-2026-mains-29-october/) is CRPD/CR/SPLDRIVE/2026-27/16. The regular recruitment is /17. Their vacancies, candidate pools, links and timing can differ even when both are described as “SBI Clerk 2026”.

Keep the application and relevant notice together. Open the careers entry for the matching advertisement, then use its result or call-letter link. If a download fails, check whether the window and stage apply to you before assuming a technical fault. Never send a password to an unofficial support account.

sections.title: Use mains review to improve selection
sections.body:
Record which reasoning or DI set you chose first and what made it attractive. After the mock, inspect whether the set yielded useful information quickly or trapped you in unnecessary cases. Retry one avoided set with a different representation.

For arithmetic, practise comparing quantities before doing exact calculation when the question permits it. Verify units and totals. Keep English mistakes separate from speed problems. Read the current advertisement and handout for the paper structure and timers; an old mock may not match the current stage. The [Clerk pattern page](/exams/sbi-clerk/exam-pattern/) is a starting summary.

sections.title: Revise awareness with retrieval, not only scrolling
sections.body:
Choose a small set of banking, economy and relevant current-affairs items from dated reliable sources. Cover the notes and explain the event, institution and consequence. If a rate or appointment is time-sensitive, recheck it close to the exam rather than preserving an old clipping as current.

Keep a missed-facts list with prompts on one side and answers on the other. Test yesterday's items before adding new ones. This is a suggested recall routine, not an official list of “sure questions”. Combine it with [current-affairs study methods](/study-guides/current-affairs-revision-method/) if that guide matches your needs.

sections.title: Read local-language and joining conditions early
sections.body:
Check the chosen state/circle's specified language and the accepted evidence or test conditions in your advertisement. Do not assume the prelims or mains result removes a language requirement. Also review identity, qualification and claimed-category documents for consistency.

For exam day, follow your own call letter for reporting, permitted items and original ID. For a later selection, wait for SBI's formal instructions rather than treating a provisional status as a joining order. Keep the regular and special-drive document folders separate if you applied under more than one advertisement.

drills.prompt: A data set totals 500, and one category accounts for 175. What is its share?
drills.explanation: 175/500 × 100 = 35. Identify the total before using a percentage shortcut.

drills.prompt: You applied under advertisement /17. Does a /16 special-drive call letter announce your mains date?
drills.explanation: The advertisement must match your own application. A shared recruitment name does not merge the drives.

checklist: Use the correct drive’s notice and call-letter link.
Review why I selected one DI or reasoning set.
Test a small awareness list from memory.
Check local-language evidence for my state/circle.

sources.label: SBI careers: match the advertisement number

faqs.q: Is 29 October the mains date for every SBI Clerk applicant?
faqs.a: No. The verified 29 October listing concerns the special drive /16.

faqs.q: Can I ignore language requirements after a good mains score?
faqs.a: No. Follow the advertisement’s language evidence and test provisions.
